snippet.title: Hubert - Coming to PS5 & Steam | October 2026
snippet.description:
Hubert is barking this October!

Follow a shepherd dog’s journey through a beautiful and mysterious forest in this heartfelt adventure about friendship, courage, and finding your way home.

Coming to PS5 and Steam in October 2026.

Wishlist Hubert on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/764930/Hubert/
